EM1801

CAUTIONS

NO!
1. Do not bend, twist or turn the belt inside out.

2. Do not allow the belt to come into contact with oil, water or steam.

EM0126

INSPECTION AND ADJUSTMENT OF VALVE TIMING

1. DISCONNECT CABLE FROM NEGATIVE TERMINAL OF BATTERY

2. REMOVE NO.2 FAN SHROUD

3. REMOVE AIR INTAKE CONNECTOR
